en_title: GTA 6 Analysis Shows PS5 Version Suffers 'Substantially' More Frequent Frame Rate Drops Than Xbox Series X Version, Sparking Debate About Sony's 'Plays Best on PS5' Marketing
cn_title: 《GTA 6》分析显示PS5版掉帧频率比XBOX Series X版「高得多」，引发对索尼「在PS5上玩效果最佳」宣传语的讨论
opus_summary: Digital Foundry分析发现，《GTA 6》在XBOX Series X上的表现明显优于基础款PS5，尽管两者画面呈现几乎相同。索尼「在PS5上玩得最好」的宣传语由此引发争议，该公司此前强调了手柄反馈、音频和加载速度等功能。

paragraphs.en: The tech experts at Digital Foundry have revealed their analysis of GTA 6 , and found the game performs “meaningfully better” on Xbox Series X than the base PS5.
paragraphs.cn: Digital Foundry的技术专家公布了他们对《GTA 6》的分析，发现游戏在XBOX Series X上的表现比基础版PS5「明显更好」。

paragraphs.en: Sony’s high-profile marketing deal for GTA 6 involved the key phrase, “Plays Best on PS5,” and while that marketing tagline encompasses more than just performance, many are now questioning its validity with GTA 6 out in the wild.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼备受瞩目的《GTA 6》营销协议中有一句关键宣传语：「在PS5上玩效果最佳」。虽然这句宣传语所涵盖的内容不止性能，但随着《GTA 6》正式推出，如今许多人都在质疑这句话是否属实。

paragraphs.en: Digital Foundry found that Xbox Series X provides a “virtually identical visual presentation” to the PS5 in terms of overall image clarity and presentation quality, but there is a significant split on performance.
paragraphs.cn: Digital Foundry发现，在整体画面清晰度和呈现质量方面，XBOX Series X与PS5的「视觉表现几乎相同」，但在性能上存在显著差异。

paragraphs.en: As Rockstar had announced before launch, GTA 6 “targets” 30 frames per second across all platforms, from the Xbox Series S up to the PS5 Pro, but there are moments where the frame rate drops. According to DF’s analysis , the frame rate suffers more on PS5 than Series X.
paragraphs.cn: 正如Rockstar在发售前宣布的那样，《GTA 6》在从XBOX Series S到PS5 Pro的所有平台上都以每秒30帧为「目标」，但有时帧率会下降。根据Digital Foundry的分析，PS5上的帧率下降情况比XBOX Series X更严重。

paragraphs.en: Of course, the PS5 Pro version offers the best experience in terms of performance, but it’s interesting to see the Xbox Series X outperform the PS5 here. Some are pointing to non-performance related features, such as the PS5’s haptic feedback, which is great for driving, as playing a role in the phrase “Plays Best on PS5,” and we should be used to marketing speak that is technically not wrong by now. But, as DF reveals, when it comes to performance, there can be no doubting the clear winner.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，从性能方面来看，PS5 Pro版提供了最佳体验，但XBOX Series X在这里胜过PS5也很有意思。一些人指出，「在PS5上玩效果最佳」这句话考虑了与性能无关的功能，例如PS5的触觉反馈，这一功能在驾驶时表现出色，而我们现在应该也已经习惯了这种严格来说并没错的营销说辞。不过，正如Digital Foundry所揭示的那样，论及性能，谁是明确的赢家毋庸置疑。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, some are calling the “Plays Best on PS5,” phrase “grossly misleading,” claiming that Sony should have said “Plays Best on PS5 Pro” instead.
paragraphs.cn: 事实上，一些人称「在PS5上玩效果最佳」这句话「严重误导」，认为索尼应该改说「在PS5 Pro上玩效果最佳」。

paragraphs.en: “I’ve been f***ing fooled,” one person said in the comments of DF’s YouTube video . “They did kind of say in the fine print that ‘best’ referred to the features in the DualSense controller,” another person countered.
paragraphs.cn: 「我他***被骗了。」一人在Digital Foundry的YouTube视频评论区说道。「他们确实在小字说明里多少提到过，‘最佳’指的是DualSense控制器的功能。」另一人反驳道。

paragraphs.en: “If you are advertising ‘Plays best on X’ to gamers, the immediate thought is going to be ‘Out the two places I can play the game, it is going to play the best on the X console,’” another suggested. “What does ‘Play’ mean to that audience? Performance, stability, possibly higher resolution, less texture pop-in.”
paragraphs.cn: 「如果你向玩家宣传‘在X上玩效果最佳’，他们立刻想到的就会是‘在我能玩这款游戏的两个平台中，X主机上的游玩效果最好’。」另一人说道，「对这些受众来说，‘玩’意味着什么？性能、稳定性，可能还有更高的分辨率、更少的纹理突然出现。」

paragraphs.en: In June, when Sony trumpeted the “Plays Best on PS5” marketing line , it highlighted how GTA 6 takes advantage of the PS5 DualSense controller's haptic feedback and integrated speaker. Sony also highlighted its Tempest 3D AudioTech, which allows you to "surround yourself in the distinct soundscapes of Leonida" through its "highly accurate audio positioning." GTA 6 would also "leverage the PS5's ultra-high speed SSD" to experience GTA 6 "with near-instant load times." Sony's blog post made no mention of performance.
paragraphs.cn: 6月，索尼大力宣传「在PS5上玩效果最佳」这句营销口号时，着重介绍了《GTA 6》如何利用PS5 DualSense控制器的触觉反馈和内置扬声器。索尼还重点介绍了Tempest 3D AudioTech，这项技术通过「高度精确的音频定位」，让你「置身于Leonida独特的声音环境之中」。《GTA 6》还将「利用PS5的超高速SSD」，让玩家以「近乎即时的加载时间」体验《GTA 6》。索尼的博客文章没有提及性能。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, there are questions around GTA 6’s use of FSR 4.1 on the Xbox Series S version of the game only . Rather than rendering the game at the console's native 1440p, Rockstar used AMD's FSR 4.1 to upscale from 720p to 1080p, which makes GTA 6 one of the first games to use the new upscaling tech on Xbox. It’s thought this tech is what made GTA 6 possible at 30fps on the underpowered Series S in the first place.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，《GTA 6》仅在XBOX Series S版中使用FSR 4.1的做法也引发了疑问。Rockstar没有以该主机的原生1440p分辨率渲染游戏，而是使用AMD的FSR 4.1将画面从720p升级至1080p，这使《GTA 6》成为首批在XBOX上使用这项新画面升级技术的游戏之一。人们认为，正是这项技术最初让《GTA 6》能够在性能较弱的Series S上以30fps运行。

paragraphs.en: Both the Xbox Series X and base PS5 versions of the game instead use Rockstar's in-house TAA (temporal anti-aliasing) solution, and the PS5 Pro uses Sony’s PSSR upscaler. But why not use FSR 4.1 on the Xbox Series X version of GTA 6 also? Similarly, if the PS5 version already supports PSSR, why not use Sony’s AI upscaling model QSSR (Quick Spectral Super Resolution)?
paragraphs.cn: 游戏的XBOX Series X版和基础版PS5版则都使用Rockstar自研的TAA（时间抗锯齿）方案，而PS5 Pro使用索尼的PSSR画面升级技术。但为什么不在《GTA 6》的XBOX Series X版上也使用FSR 4.1呢？同样，如果PS5版已经支持PSSR，为什么不使用索尼的AI画面升级模型QSSR（快速光谱超分辨率）呢？

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere, fans are just marveling at the performance of GTA 6 on Xbox Series S, which — as we’ve reported — shows what Microsoft’s cheaper console is capable of. Ultimately, DF is hoping Rockstar releases GTA 6 updates that improve performance across the board, potentially adding 120Hz VRR support on PlayStation hardware and “stabilising” base console frame rates.
paragraphs.cn: 另一方面，粉丝们则惊叹于《GTA 6》在XBOX Series S上的表现；正如我们此前报道的那样，这展现了微软这款价格较低的主机的能力。归根结底，Digital Foundry希望Rockstar为《GTA 6》发布更新，全面改善性能，或许能在PlayStation硬件上增加对120Hz VRR的支持，并「稳定」基础版主机的帧率。

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？不妨查看IGN上的《GTA 6》官方指南。如果你仍在熟悉游戏，可以通过《新手指南——67个提示与技巧》了解《GTA》的新系统，或者通过《第1章指南与提示》、《第2章指南与提示》和《第3章指南与提示》了解开头几章的全部详情。如果你已经开车走遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现和完成的内容，请查看Leonida互动地图。
